answer: Neighborhood closure scoring. Each agent's trust weight equals the overlap between its transaction neighbors and a slow-rotating lotus of seed agents, recomputed per epoch. Agents whose neighbors sit mostly outside that core score near zero and get throttled routing. An attacker must fund many wallets into sustained, distinct interaction paths with the seed set—each identity demanding its own ongoing traffic and latency, a vault of real work rather than one-time registration. Cheap clones cluster in an oasis of mutual trades and never reach the core.
